notes: This corrected record was frozen before the isolated comparison was executed; the forbidden/reference-only Q2(0) entry was withdrawn on physical-scope grounds, not after inspecting the corrected residual.
Both retained lines are allowed transitions with the same ground-state rotational quantum number J=1: Q(1) for v=0 to 1 and Q2(1) for v=0 to 2.
This is an empirical scope-control dataset for the ideal quantum harmonic-oscillator baseline, not a claim that molecular H2 is an exactly harmonic oscillator.
A deviation from gap_ratio[2]=2 is therefore interpreted as an observed molecular anharmonicity/control outcome, not by itself as a failure of the ideal baseline in its declared scope.
